title: Frontend Developer
description:
Role Summary:
 As a frontend developer, you will play a crucial role in shaping the user interface and experience of our application, ensuring seamless and engaging interaction for our users You will work closely with our cross-functional team of developers, designers, and product managers to deliver a cutting-edge platform that aligns with our company's vision and values. Responsibilities: Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate designs and wireframes into high-quality, responsive and efficient components. Develop and maintain the front-end architecture to ensure the application is performant, scalable, and easy to maintain. Implement and optimize user interfaces to deliver an exceptional user experience while adhering to design guidelines and accessibility standards. Integrate with backend services and APIs to fetch and display data in real-time, ensuring a smooth flow of information for our users. Identify and address performance bottlenecks and optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability. Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, readability, and adherence to best practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define new features and functionalities, considering user feedback and business requirements. Stay updated on industry trends and advancements to continuously improve our technology stack and development processes. Role Requirements: 2-4 years of strong proficiency in React.js and its core principles along with experience in popular React.js workflows (such as Redux, Flux, or Context API). Solid understanding of web markup, including HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design principles. Excellent understanding of object-oriented JavaScript, TypeScript. Experience working with RESTful APIs and integrating with backend services using AJAX or similar technologies. Familiarity with version control systems (e.g Git) and modern front-end build tools and pipelines. Good knowledge of web performance optimization and best practices. Good knowledge of distributed real-time systems of high throughput, low latency, and highly scalable systems. Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with a strong attention to detail. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Urgent Requirement For Asp.net and React JS Developers
description:
Junior .NET Full Stack Developer Experience: 02 Years
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Department: IT / Software Development 
 About the Role We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Junior .NET Full Stack Developer to join our software development team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, SQL, JavaScript, and React.js and a passion for developing high-quality, scalable web applications. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for freshers or early-career developers who want to work across both backend and frontend technologies , gain hands-on experience in real-world application development, and grow their technical expertise in a collaborative environment. 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Application Development Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable web applications using C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, and React.js . Develop clean, maintainable, reusable, and efficient code following established coding standards. Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. Translate business requirements and technical specifications into functional software solutions. Develop new features and enhancements for existing applications. 
 Backend Development Develop robust backend applications and RESTful APIs using C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core Web API . Implement business logic, validation, authentication, authorization, and application services. Work with object-oriented programming concepts and follow appropriate design principles. Integrate applications with databases, third-party services, and external APIs. Troubleshoot and resolve backend performance and functionality issues. 
 Frontend Development Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces using JavaScript, React.js, HTML, and CSS . Create reusable React components and maintain clean frontend architecture. Integrate React applications with REST APIs and backend services. Handle application state, user interactions, form validation, and API responses. Identify and resolve frontend bugs and usability issues. 
 Database Development Design and work with relational databases using SQL . Write, optimize, and troubleshoot SQL queries, stored procedures, joins, and database operations. Perform basic database design and data modeling as required. Ensure data integrity, consistency, and efficient database access. Analyze and resolve database-related application issues. 
 Testing and Debugging Perform unit testing, integration testing, and functional testing of developed features. Debug application issues across frontend, backend, and database layers. Investigate production and development issues and implement appropriate fixes. Work closely with QA teams to resolve defects and improve application quality. 
 Deployment and Maintenance Assist with application deployment and configuration across development, testing, and production environments. Monitor applications and troubleshoot issues after deployment. Maintain and enhance existing applications based on business requirements. Participate in application performance improvement and optimization activities. 
 Collaboration Work closely with senior developers, technical leads, QA engineers, business analysts, and other stakeholders. Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality. Follow Agile/Scrum development practices where applicable. Maintain technical documentation and development-related information. Continuously learn new technologies, frameworks, tools, and development practices. 
 Required Technical Skills Strong foundation in C# and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP). Good understanding of .NET Core / modern .NET . Knowledge of ASP.NET Core and Web API development. Understanding of RESTful APIs and HTTP concepts. Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Working knowledge of JavaScript . Knowledge of React.js and component-based frontend development. Basic understanding of HTML5 and CSS3 . Understanding of frontend-backend integration. Familiarity with debugging and troubleshooting techniques. Basic understanding of software development lifecycle and version control. 
 Good to Have Knowledge of Entity Framework Core (EF Core) . Familiarity with LINQ . Knowledge of Git/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket . Understanding of ASP.NET Core Dependency Injection . Knowledge of authentication and authorization concepts such as JWT/OAuth . Familiarity with Azure or another cloud platform. Basic knowledge of Docker/containerization . Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Exposure to unit testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest . Knowledge of design patterns and SOLID principles. Experience working with third-party APIs. 
 Desired Candidate Profile 02 years of experience in software development/full-stack development. B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech/MCA/BCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, IT, or a related field. Candidates with internship or academic project experience in .NET and React.js are encouraged to apply. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Good understanding of programming fundamentals and data structures. Ability to write clean and maintainable code. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team. Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies. Candidates should have a proactive attitude and attention to detail. 
 Key Skills C# | .NET Core | ASP.NET Core | ASP.NET Web API | Web API | React.js | JavaScript | SQL | Entity Framework Core | LINQ | REST API | HTML | CSS | Git | Full Stack Development 
 What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is not only familiar with the technologies but also has a strong programming foundation, problem-solving mindset, and willingness to learn . Candidates who have developed academic, internship, or personal projects using C#, .NET Core, SQL, and React.js will be considered. Freshers with strong technical fundamentals and relevant project/internship experience can also be considered.

Key Skills: C#,asp.net,.NET,React.js,.NET Core,Fullstack Development,Javascript,sql
